ground.purpose: Dark page background; text on line-filled buttons and badges.

plate.purpose: One tonal step up: fields, lanes, tab bar, selected row, notices.

rule.purpose: Every 1 px divider and control border; timeline grid.

line.purpose: Verified seals, clip bars, current tab, primary fill, Live badge.

muted.purpose: Secondary text, inactive tabs, unchecked seal, not-monitored hatch.

foil.purpose: Focus ring, caret, selected-row outline, timeline now line.

amber.purpose: Degraded: incomplete and mismatch seals, warnings.

on-trigger.purpose: Glyph on every trigger chip; >= 4.5:1 on all five (triggerContrast.test.ts).

themes.light: Under @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) each base token takes its -light value; trigger colours and on-trigger are unchanged.
themes.overVideo: --z-ov-ground:#0e1a1f;--z-ov-ink:#e6e2d6;--z-ov-muted:#93a6a4;--z-ov-line:#5fa8a0;--z-ov-rule:#22393f (web/src/lib/overVideo.ts), set on every container drawn over video, in both themes.

headline.purpose: The one visible h1 (Keys, first run).

day.purpose: Day title in the day row.

body-field.purpose: Inputs, selects and primary button text at 16 px.

label.purpose: Tab labels, field labels, day subtitle, trigger glyphs, Live badge.

canvas.purpose: Timeline ruler, lane names and span glyphs.

scrim.purpose: Foot of live tiles and the player, under captions and controls.

overVideoPanel.purpose: Over-video button fill and reconnect / viewer-limit panels.

hatch.purpose: Not-monitored gaps in muted; tampered spans in void.

motion.name: seal-spin
motion.purpose: Verifying seal rosette; none under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: status-pulse
motion.purpose: Player status text over video while loading.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Tabs move to the top bar; Home becomes video and timeline | 22rem list.

icons.note: Paths adapted from Lucide (ISC) and redrawn; inline SVG only.

seal.decorative: Key fingerprints (40 px in the key list, 64 px on Key added) and the faded empty-player mark.

components.name: Seal
components.description: Per-clip seal at list size: a seeded rosette of rotated ellipses (verified), and the tampered VOID seal. At 44 px and above the rosette becomes three guilloché bands.

narrative.overview:
zview treats every recording like a stamped document from a security printer: banknotes, the Indonesian meterai. The ground is a deep intaglio blue-green in the dark theme and an off-white security paper in the light one; everything on it is drawn in fine 1 px rules and a few printing inks. Each clip carries its own guilloché seal, generated from the clip's id and drawn from its verification state, wherever the clip appears: event row, player, timeline bar, and the key screen, where the key's fingerprint is the same rosette.

The system is quiet so the footage and the timeline can own the space. Chrome is a top bar, a day row and a bottom tab bar, separated by rules, never boxed into cards or lifted with shadows. Density is moderate and phone-first: 44 px targets, 64 px event rows, one face at a few sizes, and tabular "serial" figures for every time so a column of clock readings reads like a register.

The world rejects the category default (a black NVR grid with a red REC dot and a dashboard of cards) and the generic Tailwind look it replaced.
keyCharacteristics: Dark intaglio ground by default; light security paper follows `prefers-color-scheme`.
Four inks with fixed meanings: teal line (verified, selection, primary action), gold foil (focus, today, now), amber (degraded), VOID red (tampered).
One face, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next; tabular figures for every time and duration.
Flat: 1 px rules and tonal plates, no shadows, no cards.
The per-clip guilloché seal is the signature; it never claims more than was checked.

rules.name: The Fixed Inks Rule
rules.body: Each ink has one meaning: line is verified or chosen, foil is focus or now, amber is degraded, void is tampered. Never reuse an ink for decoration or brand emphasis.

rules.name: The Spec Colours Rule
rules.body: The five trigger colours, their glyphs and `on-trigger` are spec-fixed. Do not retint them per theme, and never show a trigger colour without its glyph.

rules.name: The Dark Over Video Rule
rules.body: Anything drawn over video (scrims, captions, buttons, the Live badge, reconnect panels) uses the dark values in both themes, set through the over-video variables (`--z-ov-ground`, `--z-ov-ink`, `--z-ov-muted`, `--z-ov-line`, `--z-ov-rule` from `lib/overVideo.ts`). Light paper on top of footage is never correct.

rules.name: The Serial Figures Rule
rules.body: Every time, duration, count and fingerprint uses tabular figures with +0.02em tracking (the `.num` class). A column of times must align digit for digit.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next is the only face. Do not add a display face, a serif or a system mono for flavour.

rules.name: The Printed Sheet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat and separated by 1 px rules. No drop shadows, no elevated cards, no blur. If a region needs to stand out, it moves one tone to plate.

dos: **Do** separate regions with 1 px `rule` lines and one tonal step to `plate`.
**Do** keep each ink to its meaning: `line` verified or chosen, `foil` focus or now, `amber` degraded, `void` tampered.
**Do** set every time, duration and count in tabular figures (`.num`, +0.02em).
**Do** give every phone target at least 44px, and use 16px text in fields.
**Do** use the dark over-video values for anything drawn on footage, in both themes.
**Do** show a seal beside every clip and draw it from what was actually checked; unchecked stays an empty dashed ring.
**Do** print every trigger colour with its glyph in `on-trigger`.
**Do** use the authored 24px stroke icons (1.75 stroke, round caps) from the Icon set.
donts: **Don't** use drop shadows, elevated cards, card grids or blur.
**Don't** retint the trigger colours or `on-trigger` per theme; they are fixed by ui-spec §4.6.
**Don't** put light-theme paper or ink on top of video.
**Don't** let a seal or any copy claim more than was checked, or soften a tampered or mismatch state.
**Don't** fall back to the black NVR grid with a red REC dot, or default Tailwind greys.
